Frequently Asked Questions

What is the new ULTRA Prepaid Rate Plan?
ULTRA Prepaid Rate Plan is the newest Prepaid Plan that offers Unlimited Speed to Prepaid customers. This Rate Plan offers monthly, weekly & daily Internet Data Plans.
Who is eligible to subscribe to the ULTRA Prepaid Rate Plan?
Anyone who purchases a new ULTRA Prepaid SIM Pack or port-in to U Mobile is eligible to the ULTRA Prepaid Rate Plan.
Can I change from the ULTRA Prepaid Rate Plan to my previous Prepaid Rate Plan?
No, you cannot revert to your previous Rate Plan once you are on the ULTRA Prepaid Rate Plan.
What are the Data Plans I can subscribe to with the ULTRA Prepaid Rate Plan?
You can subscribe to our ULTRA Prepaid Data Plans, available in monthly, weekly, or daily options. Find out more here.

Frequently Asked Questions
ULTRA Prepaid Data Plans
ULTRA Prepaid Rate Plan
Are the Unlimited Calls that come with the ULTRA Prepaid Plans available for international calls or overseas use?
No. All Unlimited Calls are available for domestic use only. Standard IDD rates and roaming
What happens when my 5GB Hotspot quota from my ULTRA Prepaid 28 has been fully utilised?
You will not be able to access hotspot usage. However, you can purchase the Hotspot RM5/30 Days via UMB *118# or MyUMobile App.
What is ULTRA5G Priority?
ULTRA5G Priority is designed to give you a smoother, more consistent mobile experience during peak usage times or in crowded areas.
With ULTRA5G Priority, your connection is optimised to stay fast and reliable, so you can stream, browse, and stay connected with confidence when it matters most.
Find out more here.
Will I receive an SMS reminder before my ULTRA Prepaid Data Plan subscription is due for auto-renewal?
Yes. You will receive an SMS notification on your subscription status.
